156/2024 under Sections 120- Page No.# 2/3 B/294/420/406/506/34 of the IPC.

sentences.text: It is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that the petitioner has received compensation for her own plot of land and not for any plot of land belonging to the complainant as alleged by the complainant against the father of the petitioner who is named as accused No. 1 in the complaint petition.

4. It is further submitted that the petitioner's father has already been granted interim bail and on the ground of parity, the present petitioner who is a woman may also be granted bail as the petitioner is willing to co-operate with the investigation.
5.
I have considered the submissions at the Bar.
6. I have considered the submission that the petitioner is willing to co-operate with the investigation and to abide by any stringent bail conditions if imposed upon her.

7. The petitioner has admitted that she has received such an amount of compensation and she is willing to appear before the Investigating Officer and co-operate with the investigation relating to the money received as compensation.
8. It appears that there are sufficient grounds to grant interim bail.

Meanwhile, in the interim and in the event of her arrest, the petitioner shall be enlarged on bail on furnishing a bail bond of Rs. 30,000/- with a suitable Page No.# 3/3 surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority under the conditions that:
(i) The petitioner shall appear before the Investigating officer within 1 (one) week and cooperate with the investigation,
(ii) The petitioner shall appear before the Investigating officer on every fortnight till completion of investigation, and (iii) The petitioner shall not leave the jurisdiction of the Court without prior permission.
11. On breach of any of the bail conditions, bail order shall stand automatically cancelled.
12. List this matter on 08.01.2026.
JUDGE
